bullets: Moved the Freebucks row-intent logic into a shared module and added a confirm variant for unavailable balances that requires spending consent before admission.
Allowed switching from hosted inference to a user-owned provider during a resumed run exactly once, after which the user's provider keys are kept.

Registered iOS ad placements including iOS-Chat-After-Assistant-Message, iOS-Coding-After-User-Message, and iOS-Coding-After-Assistant-Message as their own attributable surface in the placements rail.
Included concurrency and slotLimit fields in session admission refusals so capacity blocks report the exact bucket and limit instead of leaving users to guess.
Added yearly billing interval types and year, price, and renewal fields to subscription tier offers and subscription info.
Raised the default postpaid advertiser credit line to $200 and set a collection threshold of $100 to start enforcing delivery limits.
Added Gravity Showcase experiment assignment and presentation telemetry for evaluating the ad placement against a control group.
